[DAY4 11:37:30 - DAY4 11:37:57]
I return to the first-floor kitchen where Katrina and Shure are standing. Shure says, "Upstairs, maybe." I walk to the sink, pick up the bread, and glance toward the dining table. "Where did it come from?" I ask. I look back at Shure; he replies, "It was in the fridge. We just couldn't find it earlier," studies the bread, and points at the refrigerator. "This is so interesting," I say. I walk to the dining table and steady a chair. Shure adds, "It's hidden behind the Arctic Ocean." I turn, walk to the refrigerator, open it, then close the door.

[DAY4 11:36:00 - DAY4 11:39:00]
The group discusses the missing bread while inspecting the kitchen and refrigerator. I initiate the conversation by noting the absence of bread on the second floor and inquire about the number of shopping bags used. Shure, Katrina, Tasha, and Lucia confirm that two bags were brought in and that the bread was initially present. Despite checking multiple compartments and floors, the bread is not immediately found, leading to speculation about who might have taken it. The discussion concludes with uncertainty about the bread’s location.

After returning downstairs, I discover the missing bread hidden behind items in the refrigerator. Shure explains that the bread was inside the fridge all along but had been overlooked, hidden behind a container labeled "Arctic Ocean." This resolves the earlier confusion about the missing bag of bread.

Following the discovery, the group prepares and shares food at the dining table. I eat a fried egg and wash my hands at the sink while Shure toasts bread. The others, including Katrina and Lucia, join in, commenting on the meal. The atmosphere shifts to a casual dining moment, concluding with shared appreciation of the food.

I then move away from the kitchen to the adjacent bedroom, where I approach the desk and unplug a data cable from the computer. Holding the cable, I turn around, signaling a transition from the kitchen activities to a different task or setting.

[DAY4 11:34:00 - DAY4 11:34:30]
I watch Shure walk into the kitchen and chat with Katrina. Katrina: "Another bag of bread." Shure: "If you sneak a bite, we won't blame you." Shure: "Just laugh it off." I stand up. Shure: "Just say it openly." I watch Katrina walk to the refrigerator. Katrina: "No, I put it in the fridge yesterday." I watch Katrina open the refrigerator. Katrina: "Is it all gone?" I walk over to Alice. Katrina: "Really?" I say, "Is there? Yes, there is." I see Alice turn around holding something. I turn my head to look at Katrina by the refrigerator. I wander around the living room. Shure: "Really, it's not here." Shure: "So weird, a bag of bread is missing." I look toward the room next to the kitchen. Shure: "Hmm." Shure: "Feeling upset." I ask, "Yesterday, I didn't use any bread, right?"
